meta.coverage: Existing researched primary catalogue plus open Reception-capable London primary/all-through schools within 5 miles of UB5 6QX.
meta.note: The primary catalogue is centred on UB5 6QX. Nearby schools are added by radius even when they cross borough boundaries; open-event dates continue to be researched from each school’s own admissions/tours pages.
meta.distanceMethod: Straight-line distance from the postcode centroid using OS National Grid eastings/northings; use live route links for road/public-transport journey distance.
meta.locationSource: Greater London Authority London Schools map service / DfE establishment attributes.

admissionsReview.note: Distance alone does not establish admission eligibility. Faith, sibling, priority radius and other oversubscription criteria must be checked against current published policy.

performanceReview.note: Progress 8 applies to secondary schools, not primary. Primary KS2 attainment and Ofsted evidence require dated official records; no unsupported ratings are inferred.
